primary.text: How does peer review change the revision behaviour of doctoral candidates?
primary.operationalisation: Speed is days from feedback to resubmission; stability is the share of revisions that survive a second review unchanged.
primary.scope: Doctoral candidates in four Belgian universities, 2026 to 2029.

method.approach: Comparative case study with interviews and document analysis.
method.procedure: Code the review reports and interviews for the mechanism linking feedback to revision.

warrant.gap_statement: Studies of peer review report satisfaction but not the mechanism by which feedback changes revision behaviour.
